title: PAR-134 VIEWPORT entity ambient CMC flags and reserved-index retention
mode: generated AC1024 DWG object-vector fast slice
scope: Retain R2007+ VIEWPORT entity ambient CMC flags, reserved index, and source-presence state
Replay supported source method/optional-string flags without normalizing source metadata
Fail closed for invalid metadata, unsupported methods, missing detached strings, and ambient data dropped by legacy targets
Leave external producer/platform qualification and unverified class-specific DXF extensions open

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §20.4.38 places ambient light color as a CMC at group 63 in R2007+ VIEWPORT entities. ODA §2.11 defines the R2004+ CMC reserved BS index as zero, followed by packed BL method/value and RC optional-name flags/TV values.

localSource.finding: DRW_Viewport retained the CMC method, scalar/RGB, and combined optional names, but discarded flags/index. Its writer reconstructed colors and wrote the indexed-only overload for non-RGB values, losing optional CMC strings and flagged-empty state.

productionSummary: Append VIEWPORT ambient CMC flags, reserved index, and metadata-presence fields after prior class members; reset clears them.
Capture raw flags/index in the bounded R2007+ parser; DXF color-group updates clear stale DWG provenance.
Preflight normalized method/scalar/RGB, reserved index, optional-string flags, detached string storage, and legacy-version loss before common-prefix output.
Replay source flags and method through the CMC writer, including flagged-empty strings; retain canonical encoding for caller-authored metadata without provenance.
changes.publicApiOrLayoutNote: Appended public fields increase DRW_Viewport object size; downstream consumers must rebuild.

generatedControls.dwgVectors: Generated AC1024 VIEWPORT frames cover C0 ByLayer with flagged-empty color name, C1 named color/book, C3 book-only color, and C2 truecolor with name/book.
generatedControls.wireWalk: Independent cursor follows ODA §20.4.38 field order and checks reserved BS, method/value, raw flags, optional strings, and index zero.
generatedControls.lifecycle: Production parser assertions cover method/scalar/RGB/names/flags/index, following-handle alignment, rewrite/readback, copy, assignment, and reset.
generatedControls.failClosed: Writer rejects nonzero reserved index, unknown flags, unflagged names, C5, flagged-empty names without detached strings, and non-default ambient fields for pre-R2007 targets before writing bytes.

evidenceLimits: Generated vectors prove local encoding/parser consistency, not independent producer semantics for VIEWPORT ambient CMC.
No persistent DWG/DXF fixture, external reader, native CAD application, full suite, or platform qualification was run.
No new VIEWPORT DXF projection was added; DXF color groups continue to clear DWG-only provenance.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty; this slice is uncommitted and unstaged.
